_meta.note: all terrain/TWI/soil recomputed from rasters at run time

E1_density.desc: rainfall landslides per km2 of each forest type; RR vs forest-wide mean density

E2_slope_niche.desc: slope distribution of each forest type on the landscape (background points)

E3_or_by_type.desc: odds of being a rainfall landslide vs broadleaf reference; raw and terrain-adjusted

E4_spline.desc: terrain-adjusted spline OR(slope) bamboo vs broadleaf, rainfall; delta-method 95% CI

E5_interaction_specs.desc: bamboo x slope interaction OR/deg across model specs (rainfall, bamboo vs broadleaf)

E6_gee_cluster.desc: bamboo x slope interaction, event-cluster-robust (sandwich) SE clustered by event

E7_spatial_cv.desc: 20km spatial-block 5-fold CV; per-fold interaction OR and rank-AUC on held-out block

E8_size_sensitivity.desc: refit interaction restricting to landslides >= area threshold (detection-bias check)

GLMM_event_re.desc: Bayesian mixed logistic w/ event random intercept (VB); predictors z-scored then interaction back-transformed to per-degree; controls assigned to nearest-case event
